source.text_it: Prima di iniziare il viaggio devono essere verificati i livelli di olio per il motore, liquido di raffreddamento e liquido lavacristalli

records.localized_text: Before starting a journey, check engine oil, coolant and windshield washer fluid levels.

source.text_it: All’inizio del viaggio è necessario verificare il livello del liquido dei freni, del liquido della batteria e lo stato delle spazzole tergicristallo

records.localized_text: At the start of a journey, check the brake fluid and battery fluid levels and the condition of the wiper blades.

source.text_it: Tutti gli autobus hanno l’obbligo di revisione periodica annuale

records.localized_text: All buses must undergo periodic inspection annually.

source.text_it: La revisione periodica di un autobus deve essere effettuata entro il mese corrispondente a quello in cui è stata sostenuta la revisione nell’anno precedente

records.localized_text: A bus's periodic inspection must be performed by the end of the month corresponding to the previous year's inspection month.

source.text_it: Prima di iniziare il viaggio, il conducente deve provvedere a verificare il funzionamento di tutti i dispositivi di illuminazione e segnalazione visiva

records.localized_text: Before starting a journey, the driver must check operation of all lighting and visual signaling devices.

source.text_it: Il conducente, prima di iniziare il viaggio, deve provvedere alla verifica di eventuali perdite d’olio dalle condotte degli organi di frenatura

records.localized_text: Before starting a journey, the driver must check for oil leaks from brake component pipes.

source.text_it: La pulizia del parabrezza non è rilevante ai fini del funzionamento e della durata delle spazzole del tergicristallo

records.localized_text: Windshield cleanliness is irrelevant to wiper blade operation and life.

source.text_it: Il conducente, prima di partire, non è tenuto a verificare la pulizia delle superfici vetrate in quanto facilmente soggette ad imbrattamento durante il percorso

records.localized_text: Before departure, the driver need not check glass cleanliness because glass can easily become dirty during the journey.

source.text_it: La pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici di un autobus deve essere verificata e comparata con i valori minimi indicati sulla carta di circolazione

records.localized_text: Bus tire inflation pressure must be checked and compared with the minimum values on the registration document.

source.text_it: Prima di iniziare qualunque viaggio con un autobus, devono essere verificati i livelli di olio del cambio di velocità e degli organi del differenziale

records.localized_text: Before every bus journey, gearbox and differential oil levels must be checked.

source.text_it: Non è consigliato, ogni qualvolta si inizi un viaggio con un autobus, controllare il livello del liquido dei freni, del liquido della batteria e lo stato delle spazzole tergicristallo

records.localized_text: It is not advisable to check brake fluid and battery fluid levels and wiper blade condition whenever starting a bus journey.

source.text_it: Tutti gli autobus hanno l’obbligo di revisione periodica biennale

records.localized_text: All buses must undergo periodic inspection every two years.

source.text_it: La revisione periodica di un autobus deve essere effettuata entro il mese successivo a quello in cui è stata sostenuta la revisione nell’anno precedente

records.localized_text: A bus's periodic inspection must be performed by the end of the month following the previous year's inspection month.

source.text_it: La circolazione di un autobus in difetto di revisione è punita con il solo ritiro della carta di circolazione

records.localized_text: Operating a bus overdue for inspection is punished only by withdrawal of the registration document.

source.text_it: La circolazione di un autobus in difetto di revisione è punita con il ritiro della patente di guida dell’autista

records.localized_text: Operating a bus overdue for inspection is punished by withdrawal of the driver's driving licence.

source.text_it: Durante il viaggio, il conducente di un autobus è tenuto a verificare in ogni momento il funzionamento di tutti i dispositivi di illuminazione e segnalazione visiva, con particolare riferimento ai dispositivi di illuminazione delle uscite di servizio

records.localized_text: During a journey, a bus driver must check at every moment that all lighting and visual signaling devices work, particularly service exit lights.

source.text_it: Il conducente prima di iniziare il viaggio non ha l’obbligo di provvedere alla verifica di eventuali perdite d’olio dalle condotte degli organi di frenatura in quanto tale incombenza spetta in ogni caso al proprietario del mezzo

records.localized_text: Before starting a journey, the driver need not check for oil leaks from brake component pipes because that task always belongs to the vehicle owner.

source.text_it: Per autobus di classe "A" si intende un autobus con posti in piedi e con numero totale di passeggeri ammesso inferiore a 22, senza contare il conducente

records.localized_text: A class A bus has standing places and an authorized total of fewer than 22 passengers, excluding the driver.

source.text_it: Per autobus di classe "B" si intende un autobus con solo posti a sedere e con numero totale di passeggeri ammesso inferiore a 22, senza contare il conducente

records.localized_text: A class B bus has only seats and an authorized total of fewer than 22 passengers, excluding the driver.

source.text_it: Per autobus di classe "I" si intende un autobus con posti in piedi e con numero totale superiore a 22, senza contare il conducente

records.localized_text: A class I bus has standing places and a total of more than 22 persons, excluding the driver.

source.text_it: Per autobus di classe "III" si intende un autobus con solo posti a sedere e con numero totale superiore a 22, senza contare il conducente

records.localized_text: A class III bus has only seats and a total of more than 22 persons, excluding the driver.

source.text_it: Un autobus con servizio interurbano senza passeggeri in piedi può appartenere alla classe "III" o alla classe "B"

records.localized_text: An interurban bus without standing passengers may be class III or class B.

source.text_it: Un autobus con servizio di NCC può appartenere alla classe "III" o alla classe "B"

records.localized_text: A chauffeur-driven hire bus may be class III or class B.

source.text_it: Un autobus con servizio urbano può appartenere alla classe "I" o alla classe "A"

records.localized_text: An urban-service bus may be class I or class A.

source.text_it: Un autobus con servizio suburbano può appartenere alla classe "I" o alla classe "A"

records.localized_text: A suburban-service bus may be class I or class A.

rows.text: Check engine oil, coolant and washer fluid before setting off: they lubricate the engine, cool it and help keep the windscreen clean, respectively.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/lorry-and-bus-show-me-tell-me-vehicle-safety-questions/lorry-and-bus-show-me-tell-me-vehicle-safety-questions — sections 2.11, 2.16 and 2.22: bus engine oil, coolant and washer level checks.
https://cumbria.gov.uk/eLibrary/Content/Internet/544/7015/4243393117.pdf — p. 21, daily vehicle checklist: oil, coolant and screenwasher levels before driving.

https://www.gov.uk/guidance/national-standard-for-driving-cars-and-light-vans-category-b/role-1-prepare-yourself-the-vehicle-and-its-passengers-for-a-journey — element 1.2.1: engine oil lubrication and coolant; washer reservoir checks.

rows.text: Checking brake fluid and wiper blades helps identify braking or visibility problems. For batteries with accessible electrolyte, check its level according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
evidence: https://cumbria.gov.uk/eLibrary/Content/Internet/544/7015/4243393117.pdf — p. 21: daily pre-drive brake fluid and wiper checks.
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — sections 1, 2 and 6: visibility, wiper condition and braking checks on buses.
https://www.trojanbattery.com/resources/battery-maintenance — Watering, flooded batteries only: maintain electrolyte above plates; frequency depends on use and charging.
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/annex-6-vehicle-maintenance-safety-and-security — Fluid levels: low brake fluid may cause brake failure.

rows.text: Buses are passenger vehicles with more than nine seats in total and require an annual inspection.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-80/ — art. 80(4): annual inspection for passenger vehicles with more than nine seats including driver.
https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-54/ — art. 54(1)(b): bus has more than nine seats including driver.

rows.text: The next inspection is annual and normally falls due at the end of the same month as the previous inspection.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-80/ — art. 80(4): annual inspection.
https://www.mit.gov.it/sites/default/files/media/basic/2020-12/circolare-ministero-interno-24novembre2020-prot300-A-8971-20-101-3-3-9.pdf — p. 5 note 5: end of corresponding month.

rows.text: Working lights and indicators let the driver see and make the vehicle and its manoeuvres visible; check them before departure.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — checks before journey, section 20: lights and indicators.

rows.text: A leak from hydraulic brake lines can impair braking: look for leaks before setting off.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/guide-to-maintaining-roadworthiness/guide-to-maintaining-roadworthiness-commercial-goods-and-passenger-carrying-vehicles — daily checks: check braking system for leaks.
https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ — vehicles must be kept efficient and safe.

rows.text: A dirty windscreen can interfere with the wipers; cleaning the glass and rubber helps them work properly.
evidence: https://www.hella.com/lightstyle/pl/koniec-z-piszczeniem-i-nierowna-praca-wskazowki-dotyczace-cichej-pracy-wycieraczek.html — dirty windscreen can cause squeaking; clean glass and blades.

rows.text: The glass must provide visibility from the start: it may become dirty during the journey, but that does not remove the need to check it beforehand.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — before journey, section 1: unobstructed front visibility and glass.

rows.text: Compare the pressure with the manufacturer’s recommendation for the vehicle and load, using the owner’s manual; this is distinct from the registration document.
evidence: https://parma.aci.it/MANUTENZIONE-DEGLI-PNEUMATICI — ACI Parma, Qual è la corretta pressione di gonfiaggio: manufacturer-recommended pressures are usually in the use and maintenance manual, with normal and loaded values.

https://ancona.aci.it/IMG/UserFiles/Files/lettera%20Segretario%20Generale%20ASSOGOMMA.pdf — Assogomma, Pneumatici invernali – Inverno in sicurezza, question on registration document: the document indicates tyre sizes approved for the vehicle; compare the ACI pressure guidance above.
https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — truck/bus tyre pressure varies with load and operation.

rows.text: Gearbox and differential oil checks form part of the vehicle’s scheduled maintenance: they are not presumed to be required before every journey. Follow the manufacturer’s instructions.
evidence: https://dtnacontent-dtna.prd.freightliner.com/content/dam/public/dtna-servicelit/dtna/pdfs/en_us/freightliner/drivers-manuals/108SD%20and%20114SD%20Maintenance%20Manual_.pdf — Freightliner 108SD/114SD Maintenance Manual, group 00, Tables 1 and 3 (pp. 00/2–00/4): scheduled M1 includes operations 26-01 transmission fluid level and 35-01 rear axle lubricant level; M1 frequency depends on service schedule. Groups 26-01 and 35-01 describe the checks. This truck is an example, not a universal interval or Italian legal rule.

https://ik.imagekit.io/isuzu/servicing/2025/April/MVR_Bus_20000km_Service_Schedule_March_2025.pdf — Isuzu MVR Bus MY 2022 service schedule, differential/axles table: rear axle differential gear oil is inspected or replaced at scheduled service intervals; manufacturer-specific example.
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — DVSA daily bus walkaround includes visible fluid leaks; comparative guidance, not Italian law.

rows.text: It is advisable to check brake fluid and wiper blades: an abnormal level can signal a problem and worn blades reduce visibility. Follow the manufacturer’s schedule for batteries with accessible electrolyte.
evidence: https://cumbria.gov.uk/eLibrary/Content/Internet/544/7015/4243393117.pdf — p. 21: daily pre-drive brake fluid and wiper checks.
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — sections 1, 2 and 6: bus visibility, wiper condition and brake checks.
https://www.trojanbattery.com/resources/battery-maintenance — Watering, flooded batteries only: electrolyte level and maintenance frequency depend on conditions.
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/annex-6-vehicle-maintenance-safety-and-security — Fluid levels: low brake fluid may cause brake failure.

rows.text: Buses are passenger vehicles with more than nine seats, including the driver’s: this category requires annual inspection, not inspection every two years.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-54/ — art. 54(1)(b): bus defined as passenger vehicle with more than nine seats including driver.
https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-80/ — art. 80(4): annual inspection for passenger vehicles with more than nine seats including driver, subject to the stated examination exception.

rows.text: The normal deadline is the end of the month corresponding to the previous inspection, not the following month.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-80/ — art. 80(4): annual inspection.
https://www.mit.gov.it/sites/default/files/media/basic/2020-12/circolare-ministero-interno-24novembre2020-prot300-A-8971-20-101-3-3-9.pdf — p. 5 note 5: end of corresponding month.

rows.text: Driving a vehicle that has not undergone its required inspection entails a fine and suspension from circulation until inspection, subject to the prescribed exceptions; the penalty is not solely withdrawal of the registration document.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-80/ — art. 80(14): fine and suspension pending inspection; exceptions and further penalties specified.

rows.text: Driving a vehicle that has not undergone its required inspection entails a fine and suspension from circulation until inspection, subject to the prescribed exceptions; withdrawal of the driver’s licence is not the penalty for this offence.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-80/ — art. 80(14): fine and vehicle suspension for omitted inspection.

rows.text: Check the devices before departure and monitor them during service; a driver cannot check all of them continuously while driving.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — section 20: check lights before journey.

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/guide-to-maintaining-roadworthiness/guide-to-maintaining-roadworthiness-commercial-goods-and-passenger-carrying-vehicles — daily walkaround and monitoring during operation.

rows.text: Do not rule out checking for brake leaks because the vehicle belongs to someone else: finding a leak before departure helps avoid using a defective system. The question concerns a driver’s check, distinct from maintenance.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ — art. 79(1), (2) and (4): vehicles must be efficient and safe in circulation, including braking equipment; does not prescribe this particular pre-trip check.

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/guide-to-maintaining-roadworthiness/guide-to-maintaining-roadworthiness-commercial-goods-and-passenger-carrying-vehicles — daily walkaround by driver or responsible person and checking braking system for leaks; UK technical guidance, not an Italian statutory duty.

rows.text: Class A includes vehicles with seats and space for standing passengers, with capacity up to 22 passengers excluding the driver. A capacity below 22 also falls within that limit.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/237/oj/eng — UN Regulation 107, sections 2.1.1–2.1.2: capacity and classes I, III, A and B; exactly 22 belongs to A/B.

rows.text: Class B has no provision for standing passengers and includes vehicles with capacity up to 22 passengers excluding the driver. A capacity below 22 also falls within that limit.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/237/oj/eng — UN Regulation 107, sections 2.1.1–2.1.2: capacity and classes I, III, A and B; exactly 22 belongs to A/B.

rows.text: Class I covers vehicles with capacity over 22 passengers excluding the driver, with standing space designed to allow passengers to move frequently.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/237/oj/eng — UN Regulation 107, sections 2.1.1–2.1.2: capacity and classes I, III, A and B; exactly 22 belongs to A/B.

rows.text: Class III covers vehicles with capacity over 22 passengers excluding the driver, built exclusively for seated passengers.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/237/oj/eng — UN Regulation 107, sections 2.1.1–2.1.2: capacity and classes I, III, A and B; exactly 22 belongs to A/B.

rows.text: For interurban service without standing passengers, class III is possible above 22 passengers and class B up to 22, excluding the driver.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/237/oj/eng — UN Regulation 107, sections 2.1.1–2.1.2: classes I and III apply above 22 passengers, A and B up to 22, excluding the driver; I and A accommodate standing passengers and III and B do not.

https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/id/2004/02/06/04A00979/sg — DM 23 December 2003, articles 2 and 4 and annex: classification and service correspondence; the annex is a one-way correspondence from the 1977 classifications.

https://www.prassicoop.it/norme/DM%20TRASPORTI%2023_12_03.pdf — readable transcription of the same decree, p. 4 annex: urban and suburban map to I/A, interurban without standing passengers and NCC to III/B; the footnote makes the mapping one-way. Article 2 leaves assignment to a line to the competent authority.

rows.text: A hired service with a driver can use class III or B buses: both are designed for seated passengers but have different capacities.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/237/oj/eng — UN Regulation 107, sections 2.1.1–2.1.2: classes I and III apply above 22 passengers, A and B up to 22, excluding the driver; I and A accommodate standing passengers and III and B do not.

https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/id/2004/02/06/04A00979/sg — DM 23 December 2003, articles 2 and 4 and annex: classification and service correspondence; the annex is a one-way correspondence from the 1977 classifications.

https://www.prassicoop.it/norme/DM%20TRASPORTI%2023_12_03.pdf — readable transcription of the same decree, p. 4 annex: urban and suburban map to I/A, interurban without standing passengers and NCC to III/B; the footnote makes the mapping one-way. Article 2 leaves assignment to a line to the competent authority.

rows.text: An urban service can use class I or A buses, which also provide for standing passengers; the classes differ in capacity.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/237/oj/eng — UN Regulation 107, sections 2.1.1–2.1.2: classes I and III apply above 22 passengers, A and B up to 22, excluding the driver; I and A accommodate standing passengers and III and B do not.

https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/id/2004/02/06/04A00979/sg — DM 23 December 2003, articles 2 and 4 and annex: classification and service correspondence; the annex is a one-way correspondence from the 1977 classifications.

https://www.prassicoop.it/norme/DM%20TRASPORTI%2023_12_03.pdf — readable transcription of the same decree, p. 4 annex: urban and suburban map to I/A, interurban without standing passengers and NCC to III/B; the footnote makes the mapping one-way. Article 2 leaves assignment to a line to the competent authority.

rows.text: A suburban service can also use class I or A buses, which provide for standing passengers; the classes differ in capacity.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/237/oj/eng — UN Regulation 107, sections 2.1.1–2.1.2: classes I and III apply above 22 passengers, A and B up to 22, excluding the driver; I and A accommodate standing passengers and III and B do not.

https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/id/2004/02/06/04A00979/sg — DM 23 December 2003, articles 2 and 4 and annex: classification and service correspondence; the annex is a one-way correspondence from the 1977 classifications.

https://www.prassicoop.it/norme/DM%20TRASPORTI%2023_12_03.pdf — readable transcription of the same decree, p. 4 annex: urban and suburban map to I/A, interurban without standing passengers and NCC to III/B; the footnote makes the mapping one-way. Article 2 leaves assignment to a line to the competent authority.
